{{Top|ga}} {{Character |type= |image=[[File:DobbuScay-CGttSWG.png]] |name=Dobbu Scay |homeworld=[[Emkhamarill]]''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' |birth= |death= |species=[[Khamarill]] |gender= |pronouns=He/him''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: A Junior Novel]]'' |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Brown]]{{Film|VIII}} |feathers= |eyes=Brown |skin=Gray |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation= |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Ah, yeah!|Dobbu Scay finds what he thinks is a lugjack machine|audio=Scay-Yeah.flac|}} '''Dobbu Scay''' was a [[Khamarill]] [[gambler]] from [[Emkhamarill]] who was present in the [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Casino]] on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]] in [[34 ABY]]. While [[Alcohol|inebriated]] at the [[casino]], he mistook the [[Resistance]] [[BB-series astromech droid|astromech droid]] [[BB-8]] for a [[lugjack]] [[Slot machine|machine]] and began inserting [[cantocoin]]s into various slots on the [[Astromech droid|droid]]. BB-8 encouraged Scay to insert more coins until the [[droid]] [[Mission to Canto Bight|dashed off]] to rejoin his companions, [[Finn]] and [[Rose Tico]]. When a herd of [[fathier]]s later stampeded through the casino, Scay laughed gleefully as coins cascaded onto the floor around him in the chaos, allowing him to recoup his loses. ==Biography== ===Drunk at the casino=== {{Quote|A drunk alien in a tuxedo thought you were a slot machine? Fair enough.|DJ learns about BB-8's encounter with Dobbu Scay|[[The Last Jedi Adaptation 3|''The Last Jedi Adaptation'' 3]]}} [[File:Dobbu_Scay_and_BB-8.png|thumb|left|300px|Dobbu Scay mistook BB-8 for a lugjack machine.]] Dobbu Scay was a [[Khamarill]] from [[Emkhamarill]]. Shortly after the outbreak of the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]] in [[34 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VIII}}, which includes Dobbu Scay's appearance, to [[34 ABY]]. the unaffiliated Scay was on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]] in the [[city]] of [[Canto Bight]]. While [[gambling]] in the [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Casino]],''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Expanded Edition]]'' he became [[Alcohol|inebriated]] and approached the Resistance [[BB-series astromech droid|astromech droid]] [[BB-8]] on the [[casino]]'s floor. Having already lost most of his spending money, he mistook the [[Astromech droid|droid]] for a [[lugjack]] machine, and inserted one of his stack of [[cantocoin]]s into a diagnostic slot in BB-8's tool bay. This caused the [[droid]] to squawk in shock, but when nothing else happened, Scay squinted and leaned against the droid to belch angrily before inserting another coin. BB-8 remained stock still and began beeping encouragingly for Scay to insert more coins. When the [[gambler]] did so, the droid warbled happily and flashed the diagnostic light on his head in order to imitate a [[slot machine]] before making a sad, droopy coo. Scay then inserted a coin into the droid's [[dataport]] and continued to inset more until he had emptied out his remaining coins. ===Riches from chaos=== {{Quote|Hee-hee-hee-hee-hee!|Dobbu Scay laughs as cantocoins cascade down around him|audio=Scay-Laugh.flac|}} [[File:Dobbu_Scay_money_pile.png|thumb|right|300px|When fathiers crashed through the casino, Dobbu Scay found himself surrounded by cantocoins.]] BB-8 eventually left to find his companions, [[Finn]] and [[Rose Tico]], after spotting the [[Master Codebreaker]], for whom they were [[Mission to Canto Bight|searching]]. The droid later used Scay's coins as projectiles in order to subdue a member of the [[Canto Bight Police Department]] during the group's escape from Cantonica with the criminal [[DJ]]. Scay remained in the casino and was still present when Finn and Tico rode through the building on a herd of [[fathier]]s that they had freed. During the ensuing chaos, a large amount of cantocoins cascaded from one of the casino's tables onto Scay and the floor around him, causing him to laugh with glee and begin gathering them up. He was able to recoup his earlier loses from the winnings dropped by other panicked patrons. ==Personality and traits== {{Listen3|Scay-Belch.flac|Dobbu Scay belches|Dobbu Scay becomes frustrated with BB-8 and belches}} [[File:Dobbu_Scay.png|thumb|left|160px|Scay spent most of his time gambling inebriated.]] Dobbu Scay had [[Color|gray]] skin, brown [[hair]], and brown [[eye]]s. He spoke in the [[Khamarese]] [[language]].{{SWKidsYouTube|series=Star Wars By the Numbers|text=Every Language in Star Wars Movies|video=CZp8Civk2co|nolive=1}} While on Cantonica, Scay was unable to maintain any self-control when faced with the world's vast array of distracitons and was inebriated for most of the time he spent gambling. Scay was inebriated enough at the Canto Bight casino to mistake a BB-series astromech droid for a slot machine and became frustrated when he did not win any coins from BB-8. However, he was greatly pleased when he later found himself surrounded by coins while chaos reigned around him in the casino. ==Equipment== While in the casino, Scay wore a [[monocle]] and a black [[Clothing|suit]] with black shoes, a gray shirt, and a brown sash around his waist. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Mark Hamill's credited twice in the credits.''"
"''Oh, that's right! He is also Dobbu Scay, who is named after Bob Ducsay, the editor.|[[Lucasfilm Story Group]] members [[Matt Martin]] and [[Pablo Hidalgo]]|audio=Matt_and_Pablo-Dobbu_Scay.flac|{{StarWarsShow|p09c0MXDxto|Star Wars: The Last Jedi Secrets Explained|sw_url=video/secrets-explained-the-last-jedi}}}} [[File:DobbuConcept.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Jake Lunt Davies drew concept art of Dobbu Scay.]] Dobbu Scay was a [[Wikipedia:Computer-generated imagery|computer-generated]] character created for the [[2017]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']], in which he was voiced by [[Mark Hamill]], whose main role in the film was that of [[Luke Skywalker]]. Hamill also filmed the Dobbu Scay scene, using a [[Wikipedia:Mo-cap suit|full-motion capture suit]] with a giant-sized [[Wikipedia:Medicine ball|medicine ball]] to reduce his height to that of BB-8, though he did not expect to be credited for the role of Scay and assumed that it was just a simple [[Easter egg (virtual)|Easter egg]].{{Twitter|HamillHimself|status/1145043600247406592|[[Mark Hamill]]|date=2019-06-29|quote=It is commonly (& mistakenly) reported that I only did the voice of Dobbu Scay, but I filmed the scene in a full motion-capture suit w/ a giant-sized medicine ball to make me the same size as BB-8. I didn't expect to be credited, assuming it would be another unbilled easter-egg.|archivefile=File:Mark_Hamil_Dobbu_Scay_Tweet.png}} The character's name is an anagram of [[Bob Ducsay]], who worked as the film editor on ''The Last Jedi''. [[Jake Lunt Davies]] drew concept art of the character.{{Twitter|JakeLuntDavies|status/1503151916276137989|[[Jake Lunt Davies]]|quote=Design for Dobbu Scay, the little alien gambler confusedly thinking BB8 was a slot machine in The Last Jedi. Cameo performance by @hamillhimself|date=2022-03-14|archivedate=20220314012144}} On the [[May 17]], [[2021]], Dobbu Scay's name was misspelt as "Dabbu Scay" in an episode of the [[Wikipedia:YouTube|YouTube]] series [[Star Wars Full Circle]] titled "[[Clone Force 99]]," which was produced by [[StarWarsKids.com]].{{SWKidsYouTube|series=Star Wars Full Circle|text=Clone Force
